title: EvoXplain: When Machine Learning Models Agree on Predictions but Disagree on Why: Measuring Mechanistic Multiplicity Across Training Runs
reasoning: The paper presents a diagnostic framework for measuring the stability of machine learning explanations. While it discusses 'responsible AI' and uses the COMPAS dataset (often associated with fairness research), the paper itself is a technical study on the statistical properties of model interpretability and does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
